WITH RECURSIVE PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_TREE AS ( SELECT COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_CD , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_LVL , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_ORD , COMP_ORG.USE_YN , COMP_ORG.DELT_YN , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM::VARCHAR(255) AS PRJCT_ORG_TREE_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_DESC , COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , NULL::VARCHAR(255) AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD::VARCHAR(255) AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD_PATH , LPAD(COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_ORD::TEXT, 3, '0')::VARCHAR(255) AS PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH FROM PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL COMP_ORG LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL PRNT_COMP_ORG ON PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ AND COMP_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_BSC_INFO_TBL COMP_BSC_ORG ON COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ = COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ AND COMP_BSC_ORG.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COMP_BSC_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ IS NULL AND COMP_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N'
UNION ALL
SELECT PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_CD , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_LVL , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_ORD , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.USE_YN , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.DELT_YN , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_NM , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM , (PRJCT_ORG_TREE.PRJCT_ORG_TREE_NM || ' > ' || PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM)::VARCHAR(255) AS PRJCT_ORG_TREE_NM , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_DESC , PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD::VARCHAR(255) AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_NM , (PRJCT_ORG_TREE.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD_PATH || ',' || PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD)::VARCHAR(255) AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD_PATH , (PRJCT_ORG_TREE.PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH || '-' || LPAD(PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_ORD::TEXT, 3, '0'))::VARCHAR(255) AS PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH FROM PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL PRJCT_COMP_ORG INNER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_TREE PRJCT_ORG_TREE ON PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = PRJCT_ORG_TREE.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL PRNT_COMP_ORG ON PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = PRJCT_COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ AND PRJCT_COMP_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' LEFT JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_BSC_INFO_TBL COMP_BSC_ORG ON PRJCT_COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ = COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ AND COMP_BSC_ORG.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COMP_BSC_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1 AND PRJCT_COMP_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' ) SELECT PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , COMP_ORG_SEQ , COMP_CD , PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRJCT_ORG_LVL , PRJCT_ORG_ORD , USE_YN , DELT_YN , COMP_NM , PRJCT_ORG_NM , PRJCT_ORG_TREE_NM , PRJCT_ORG_DESC , PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_NM , PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD_PATH , PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH FROM PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_TREE WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND DELT_YN = 'N' AND COMP_ORG_SEQ = #{compOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH

SELECT COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , COMP_ORG_VIEW.COMP_ORG_SEQ , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_CD , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_CD , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_LVL , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_ORD , COMP_ORG_VIEW.USE_YN , COMP_ORG_VIEW.DELT_YN , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_NM , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_TREE_NM , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_DESC , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD_PATH , COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_SORT_PATH FROM PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_VIEW COMP_ORG_VIEW LEFT JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL COMP_ORG ON COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL PRNT_COMP_ORG ON PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = COMP_ORG_VIEW.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ LEFT JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_BSC_INFO_TBL COMP_BSC_ORG ON COMP_ORG_VIEW.COMP_ORG_SEQ = COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ AND COMP_BSC_ORG.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COMP_BSC_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMP_ORG_VIEW.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COMP_ORG_VIEW.DELT_YN = 'N' AND COMP_ORG_VIEW.COMP_ORG_SEQ = #{compOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC}

SELECT COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_CD , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_LVL , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_ORD , COMP_ORG.USE_YN , COMP_ORG.DELT_YN , COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_CD , PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_NM AS PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_NM , COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_DESC , COMP_ORG.RGST_DT , COMP_ORG.RGST_SEQ , COMP_ORG.RGST_NM , COMP_ORG.UPDT_DT , COMP_ORG.UPDT_SEQ , COMP_ORG.UPDT_NM , COMP_ORG.DELT_DT , COMP_ORG.DELT_SEQ , COMP_ORG.DELT_NM FROM PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL COMP_ORG LEFT OUTER JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_INFO_TBL PRNT_COMP_ORG ON PRNT_COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = COMP_ORG.PRNT_PRJCT_ORG_SEQ LEFT JOIN PRJ_PRJCT_COMP_ORG_BSC_INFO_TBL COMP_BSC_ORG ON COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ = COMP_BSC_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ AND COMP_BSC_ORG.USE_YN = 'Y' AND COMP_BSC_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' WHERE 1 = 1 AND COMP_ORG.DELT_YN = 'N' AND COMP_ORG.COMP_ORG_SEQ = #{compOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND (((#{prjctOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_SEQ = #{prjctOrgSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{prjctOrgCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{prjctOrgCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (COMP_ORG.PRJCT_ORG_CD = #{prjctOrgCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
